rewrites.comment: Single-page app: every path serves index.html so a magic-link return, a refresh or a deep link all boot the app instead of 404ing.

headers.comment: Hashed build output is immutable; the HTML must never be cached or a deploy leaves people on the old bundle.
The app talks to exactly one host — its own Supabase project — so the connect list is that and nothing else. Everything else is self-hosted: no CDN fonts, no analytics, no third-party scripts.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.supabase.co; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
